newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha flat to slightly firmer in quiet market.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha flat to slightly firmer in quiet market.

text.p: NWE naphtha was flat to slightly stronger on Tuesday in a quiet market, traders said.
Swaps were quoted at $186.00/$186.50 for April, and the same for the May contract.
"It's on the verge of going back into backwardation," said one trader.
"I don't think there is anything fundamental behind it, just a couple of players are trying higher April levels."
The market continued to monitor the situation in the Asian markets which saw fall to a six-month low in Japan and a five-month low in Singapore on Monday.
Prices appeared to have steadied on Tuesday with open-spec naphtha cargoes for both first and second half June quoted around $209/$210 pre tonne, against $208/$209.50 on Monday.
